slides.alt: A 70 percent dark chocolate bar in its wrapper, half chopped, on a wooden board with a knife. Text: October was the month of birthdays in my family.
Chocolate cake batter in a springform pan inside the oven. Text: And I got to make delicious low-sugar cakes.

Baking ingredients on a wooden counter: cocoa, almond flour, butter, sour cream, eggs and a bowl of dates. Text: This one was with dates, butter, almond flour, sour cherries from the garden (preserved).
The finished chocolate cake with a slice taken out. Text: The result was naturally sweet, firm in texture, and some cream mixed with a pinch of sugar was all that was needed for the finish.
A kitchen sink with a mixing bowl, whisk, wooden spoon and knife in soapy water after the baking.
